comment: Batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents, W2b: the pilot records of the test overlay src/test/resources/materials/pilot-aqueous (not main data): ethanol from ChemSep with its homomorph, and water as a compound of the cubic. Its pairs are derived (MaterialCatalog derived pairs), so no pair library is written.

homomorph.source: The hydrocarbon homomorph of ethanol: its OH read as CH3 (CH3-CH2-OH as CH3-CH2-CH3). A gas without modified UNIFAC groups takes the E-PPR78 k_ij(T) it has with propane, on propane's own Tc, Pc and acentric factor (tools/aqueous-solvents/gas-in-organics.mjs: N2, CH4, CO2 in ethanol at 25 C within 0.85 to 0.93 of the measured solubility).

cubic_water.source: Water as a compound of the PR78 cubic (batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents, plan M2), a test pilot: IAPWS-95 critical point (Tc 647.096 K, Pc 22.064 MPa), acentric factor 0.3443, normal boiling point 373.124 K, standard liquid density 999.0 kg/m3 at 60 F (IAPWS-95, rounded); Mathias-Copeman alpha c1 0.91976, c2 -0.33844, c3 0.33431 matched to the Wagner-Pruss saturation line from 0 to 370 C (tools/aqueous-solvents/cubic-water.mjs).

modified-unifac-dortmund.source: Water is the one subgroup H2O (subgroup 16, main group 7) of modified UNIFAC (Dortmund).

eppr78-2022.source: Water is the one group H2O (G16) of E-PPR78 (Jaubert et al. 2022).
